Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE Legal Opinion No. 73 s. 2011 NOV 10 2011 PUNONG BARANGAY RAMON ENCARNACION Liga President, Valenzuela Chapter 3rd Floor Valenzuela City Convention Center Malinta, Valenzuela City Dear Punong Barangay Encarnacion: This pertains to your letter requesting this Department for the legal interpretation of Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59, specifically the meaning of the phrase "strongly discourage to conduct of seminar, training, workshop and similar activity outside the geographical island where the concerned local government unit is located", particularly the word "geographical island" in relation to the allowable venue of the seminars, and trainings which will be conducted by the barangays of Valenzuela City in the future. In reply thereto, please be informed that we have already interpreted the term "geographical islands" mentioned under the DILG-Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59 in our opinion no. 65 s. 2011. Hence, we would like to reiterate our opinion no. 65 s. 2011 thus: "The term iigeographical islands" mentioned under the DILG-Memorandum the D/LG-Memorandum Circular No. 2011-59 refers to the three (3) main islands of the namely Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao. Hence, if your Philippines, barangay/municipality/city is located in Luzon, trainings, seminars, workshop or similar activities are strongly encouraged to be within the island of Luzon. xxx xxx xxx Along this line, may we invite your attention to the 4th paragraph of the same Memorandum Circular which provides that liStUdy Tour or similar activity anchored on good practices may be held outside of the geographical islands, provided that it is drawn from the list of publicly recognized good practices downloadable from but not limited to the website of the Galing Pook Foundation (www.galingpook.org), of the Local Government Academy (www.lga.gov.ph) and this Department and where such initiatives has a high replicability potential in the local government concerned. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. A LS:94/11 Very truly yours, Y. JE US . DOQUE IV Director 111
